_meta.purpose: Resolve names that appear in curated content and in the bundled visual model to the taxon record actually held in this database. Only needed where GBIF Backbone Taxonomy treats a familiar cultivated name as a synonym of a different accepted name. No new taxa are created here: every target must already exist in the GBIF import.

aliases.reason: GBIF Backbone treats Citrus sinensis (Mill.) Pers. as a synonym of the accepted Citrus x aurantium L. (usageKey 3190158 -> acceptedKey 8077391). Sweet orange is therefore held under the sweet/sour orange aggregate.
